description: This Java class 'NotificationService' manages event notifications within a scheduling system. It includes methods for generating notifications based on event timings, scheduled tasks for periodic checks, and interactions with repositories for data persistence.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing notifications related to events, including scheduled checks and notification generation.

methods.name: NotificationService
methods.description: Constructor initializing repositories for event and notification data access.

methods.name: checkIfGenerateNotification
methods.description: Scheduled method that runs every 5 minutes during working hours to generate or delete notifications based on event timing.

methods.name: generateMorningNotifications
methods.description: Scheduled method that runs at 8:30 AM on weekdays to generate notifications for today's events.

methods.name: generateNotification
methods.description: Private method that creates and saves a new notification for a specific event.
